title: Middleware pipeline — concept map
intro: Every HTTP request passes through a built chain of middleware — the onion model. Code before await _next runs inbound in registration order; code after runs outbound in reverse. Order matters: exception handler outermost, routing before authentication, endpoints last. Custom middleware uses InvokeAsync; scoped services belong in InvokeAsync or IMiddleware, never the constructor.

overviewDiagram.title: Standard Web API pipeline flow
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  Client[HTTP Client] --> Kestrel[Kestrel]
  Kestrel --> EH[Exception Handler\noutermost]
  EH --> HTTPS[HTTPS / HSTS]
  HTTPS --> RT[UseRouting]
  RT --> AUTHN[UseAuthentication]
  AUTHN --> AUTHZ[UseAuthorization]
  AUTHZ --> EP[Endpoints\ncenter of onion]
  EP --> AUTHZ2[unwind authZ]
  AUTHZ2 --> AUTHN2[unwind authN]
  AUTHN2 --> EH2[unwind exception handler]
  EH2 --> Client2[HTTP Response]

conceptCards.title: Onion model
conceptCards.summary: Registration order = outside-in inbound. await _next delegates inward. Post-_next code runs reverse order outbound. Endpoint is the center.

conceptCards.title: Middleware order
conceptCards.summary: Exception handler first. Routing before auth. Authentication before authorization. MapControllers last. Wrong order = raw 500 or anonymous access.

conceptCards.title: Exception handling
conceptCards.summary: UseExceptionHandler wraps the pipeline. IExceptionHandler + Problem Details for RFC 7807 JSON. Developer page dev-only.

conceptCards.title: Custom middleware
conceptCards.summary: InvokeAsync(HttpContext) + await _next. IMiddleware for per-request activation. Correlation IDs via OnStarting and log scopes.

conceptCards.title: Short-circuiting
conceptCards.summary: Run terminates branch. Map forks by path — skips later main-branch middleware. Health probes often Map before auth.

conceptCards.title: Scoped in middleware
conceptCards.summary: Middleware class is singleton. Scoped DbContext in constructor = captive dependency. Use InvokeAsync injection or IMiddleware.
conceptCards.example: public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext ctx, AppDbContext db)
